changelog:
📐 Settings rows keep their field level with the title: a setting an environment variable sets shows a "Set by" badge, and long warnings sit in a strip along the bottom of the row.
📱 Card actions stay beside their title at every width: where the labels do not fit, buttons show only their icon and a tab switch becomes one button that cycles, alike on every page. Buttons have even padding on both sides.
🧠 Thinking a client replays as <think> text no longer makes Claude refuse, Sonnet on Kiro's newer chat API accepts a history with several thinking blocks, and a refused request says so in the request log.
